title: the nether edition resource pack
description: This resource pack changes alot of the textures to be nether themed
body:
This resource pack makes most textures nether themed, like the buttons, the title, the edition, the hearts, and alot more! it should work with some mods, if you're on 1.21.4


the resource pack also adds new splash texts, and taking some from bedrock edition
